items.title: Türkiye first in the live sampler and the nightly seed
items.note: Turkish aircraft go to the front of the 60 live candidates, and the seed takes every labelable Turkish row before its worldwide sample (config.PRIORITY_BBOX). Expect a few climbs a day: that is all the OGN feed holds for Türkiye until receivers or flight logs add more.

items.title: Check the one-time Türkiye catch-up ran
items.note: No admin key needed any more: the first nightly seed (02:00 UTC) after this shipped takes every Turkish row on the VM from the last 60 days by itself. /training/status shows the result under priority_catchup (done, priority_added). Tick this off once it says done.

items.title: Ask THK İnönü: an OGN receiver on site, and their gliders' IGC logs
items.note: A receiver is a Raspberry Pi, an RTL-SDR dongle and an 868 MHz antenna (about €100-200), plus internet and permission. It would hear FLARM, FANET and OGN trackers about every second, as the Alps are heard. Also ask whether their gliders carry FLARM: no glider has ever been seen within 25 km of İnönü, but nobody there is listening.

items.title: Second OGN receiver near Babadağ / Ölüdeniz
items.note: Where most of the Turkish climbs in our archive cluster (around 36.5N 29.1E), almost all paragliders.

items.title: Data agreements for Turkish flight logs
items.note: ypforum (Türkiye Yamaç Paraşütü; thermal.kk7.ch already uses it as a source). XContest: no API and no data terms, contact info@xcontest.org. thermal.kk7.ch: CC BY-NC-SA, commercial use needs its author's licence. WeGlide: commercial use needs written approval.

items.title: IGC importer, once logs arrive
items.note: Turns 1-second flight logs into training rows with the same labels, filters and real-weather-only fetches as live data.

items.title: Satellite LST measurement (MODIS + MTG) merged into main
items.note: evaluation/lst.py, its tests and the CLAUDE.md entry, from branch claude/interesting-bardeen-bb8202. No production change.

items.title: Get Turkish training data (receivers and flight logs: see the items above)
items.note: The live buffer held 1 Turkish row of 78,428 (20 Nov). Measured 21 Nov on the 52-day archive: OGN heard 143 soaring aircraft over Türkiye, but only 188 climbing-circling fixes, against 1.06 million in the Alps. Turkish aircraft are heard once a minute through phone apps (median 58 s between fixes; 1.7 s in the Alps), because the OGN receiver list has no receiver in Türkiye. The pilots are there; the receivers are not.

items.title: Check the beacon archive for missing days
items.note: /training/status on 20 Nov reports 16 archived days between 21 Oct and 19 Nov. A day missing from the archive is lost to the nightly seed and to the climatology.

items.title: Score the forecast ledger from the Parquet archive too
items.note: Scoring reads only the hot DB. If the app is down past the retention window, those forecasts score no_observation_data.

items.title: Show on screen when /predict is using fallback (invented) weather
items.note: Deliberate for an offline demo, but nothing tells the viewer that the weather is not a forecast.

items.title: Label the GeoJSON export's thermal_base_m as AGL
items.note: Every altitude on screen names its reference; the export still does not.

items.title: Fill the landing page's 6 h horizon row from the ledger
items.note: It reads 'being measured' until the 360-minute horizon has scored results. Never fill it with a guess.

items.title: Bound the land-cover grid cache before ever enabling ENABLE_LANDCOVER
items.note: landcover_client._grid_cache keeps one stack per grid centre forever: the same shape as the terrain-cache leak behind the November OOM kills.

items.title: Re-derive the limits set for the old 896 MB box
items.note: The node has 3.9 GB since 19 Nov and the app container 1.5 GB. Retention, the buffer cap and cache bounds were all sized for 896 MB.

items.title: Fix the test that fails between 00:00 and 03:00 UTC
items.note: test_meteo_client.py::test_hour_index_falls_back_when_stamp_absent. A test bug, not a regression.

items.title: Put the 3D thermal blocks into the model?
items.note: +0.009 to +0.017 over hires terrain from our own OGN archive, holding 5+ km from airfields. Coverage is the limit: Türkiye has 10 well-sampled blocks. Re-measure once the archive holds a flying season.

items.title: Climatology prior (lagged climb rate per cell)
items.note: +0.014 [-0.002, +0.029] alone; nothing on top of hires terrain. Its index now builds hourly on the node, so it keeps growing.

items.title: Satellite surface temperature in summer, and for 'is today thermic'
items.note: MODIS and MTG were null in Oct-Nov, the weakest surface contrasts of the year. Re-measure on a summer buffer. Also test it for whether there is lift at all (the ledger's pooled score), not only where in the map.

items.title: Wind at height
items.note: Layer and 850 hPa wind as model columns: +0.006 / -0.004 / +0.011, unproven. Drift-corrected terrain lost in every form tried.

items.title: Tighter altitude matching in the benchmark
items.note: Dropped in September because it starved the gate (28 groups). The benchmark now holds 655 groups, so it can be revisited.

items.title: Tune the live-thermal fusion constants from the ledger
items.note: LIVE_FUSION_TAU_MIN and LIVE_FUSION_MAX_MIN. The ledger scores served and model-only maps side by side, which is the measurement to tune them on.

items.title: Why do within-map hotspots beat chance only at 15 min?
items.note: Whether there is lift holds to 3 h (pooled AUC 0.67-0.71); where in the map it sits does not. What would carry that ranking further ahead?

items.title: How much does the map extend a UAV's flight duration?
items.note: Unmeasured. The pitch presents it as the hypothesis a pilot project would measure (the 1 / (1 - f) calculator).

items.title: Does more data raise the score?
items.note: 0.542 (27 Sep) to 0.570 (16 Nov) sits inside both intervals. Track it as the buffer grows (78k rows over 66 days on 20 Nov), always over seeds 0-2: the fold seed alone moves the score 0.557-0.594.

items.title: A thermal-resolving simulation for one site?
items.note: Estimated for the pitch: one H100 for 4-7 min per 11 km site-day ($0.15-0.47), about 10x that for an ensemble, and it needs boundary conditions from a regional forecast.

items.title: Measured MTG/FCI satellite land-surface temperature (LSA-007)
items.note: 527 hourly images for the 6 Nov buffer. Adds nothing over hires terrain: -0.000 / -0.004 / +0.007 over seeds 0-2, sign changing with the seed. Only 43% of mixed-label units covered in Oct-Nov cloud, and at a 2 x 4 km pixel it mostly measures height.

items.title: Measured MODIS satellite land-surface temperature
items.note: Adds nothing over hires terrain (+0.001 / -0.004 / +0.004). Raw LST ranks lift below chance (0.43-0.47 alone): cold pixels are high ground, where gliders climb.

items.title: Thermal top applied at fit time to old buffer rows (PR #26)
items.note: Excludes 7,440 of 78,416 rows collected before the switch; benchmark 695 to 655 groups. Score unchanged.

items.title: Pitch: sourced chronology of thermal prediction, 1980-2026 (PR #25)
Clouds drawn from EUMETSAT cloud mask and cloud-top height (PRs #20, #24)
items.note: Read in the browser from public WMS as data; replaced the satellite photo overlay.

items.title: Seed buys weather by the fortnight (PR #22)
items.note: Rebuilding 28 Sep-6 Nov took 1,741 Open-Meteo calls instead of about 17,000.

items.title: Landing horizon table refreshed from the ledger (PR #23)
Thermal top replaced cape_base (PR #21)
items.note: min(boundary-layer height, cloud base). Predicts how high gliders climb: Spearman 0.73, median miss 229 m (old formula 0.55, 715 m). The training filter no longer discards real climbs on cool days.

items.title: Quality gate documented as it really works (PR #19)
items.note: It rejects only a reliably worse model, so 'accepted' is not evidence that a change helped.

items.title: Node upsized to 3.9 GB RAM, app container capped at 1.5 GB (PR #18)
Full-resolution terrain (30 m) live as model columns 22-29 (PR #17)
items.note: The first lever that clearly moves the score: +0.023 to +0.047, intervals clear of zero. The live model is 30 columns and the buffer is backfilled.

items.title: Measured 3D thermal blocks from our OGN archive (PR #16)
items.note: +0.009 to +0.017 over hires terrain, holding away from airfields. Not in production; see Research.

items.title: Ruled out: drift-corrected terrain, surface energy budget, wind-driven drift (PR #16)
items.note: Every drift shift loses to reading terrain under the glider; all of the energy budget's skill is the sun angle on the slope.

items.title: Auto-deploy: a merge to main is live in about 5 minutes (PR #14)
items.note: Cron on the VM, health-checked, with rollback.

items.title: Pitch rewritten after the TUSAŞ HANGAR BİGG mentor review (PRs #13, #15)
items.note: Low-altitude fixed-wing UAVs, civil and dual-use, flight duration (never range), maps made before flight and handed to the GCS.

Local time and sky on the map (PR #10), one wrapping world map (PR #11), visual identity (PR #9)
Forecast ledger: forecasts recorded before their time, scored after (PR #8)
items.note: Whether there is lift holds at pooled AUC 0.67-0.71 out to 3 h; within-map hotspots beat chance only at 15 min.

items.title: Forecast slider: 15-minute steps to +3 h, hourly to +23 h (PR #7)
Landing page at /about (PRs #5, #6)
Terrain caches bounded (PR #4)
items.note: Ended 28 out-of-memory kills in 8 days; point cache 196 MB to 56 MB.

items.title: Raw data vs ThermalSense comparison view (PR #1); scans made visible (PRs #2, #3)
Live sampler no longer trains on invented fallback weather
items.note: 862 of 48,281 buffer rows (1.8%) carried invented weather; load() now drops them.

items.title: Feed plausibility gate (_admit)
items.note: Shared and corrupted ids no longer jump across countries: impossible legs shown went from 822 to 34, for 0.39% of beacons rejected.

items.title: Beacon archive in Parquet, and a nightly seed from it
items.note: Every completed day kept at about 10 B per row; the 02:00 seed rebuilds yesterday's training rows, bounded by the clock since the 18 Sep outage.

items.title: Terrain from Copernicus GLO-30 instead of OpenTopoData
items.note: No key and no quota; matches GDAL exactly on 65 test points.

items.title: Presence-absence labels and the 200 m AGL floor
items.note: Circling and climbing is lift; flying straight and sinking is no lift; the middle is discarded. The floor removed the 'on the ground means no lift' leak.
